resources.string: Thinking on your device. The first run can take a minute.
Pick refresh to generate personalized picks from your watch history.
Download the on-device model to get personalized picks. Nothing leaves your phone.

Gemma 4 E2B runs entirely on this device with LiteRT-LM. Your watch history is never sent anywhere. The model file is about %1$s, is downloaded once from Hugging Face (%2$s, Apache 2.0), and needs a device with 6 GB of RAM or more.
